BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to school employee workforce reductions; adding anew section to chapter 28A.405 RCW; and creating a new section.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that educators deserveto be recognized for their ability to help students learn, and studentsdeserve the opportunity to learn from the most competent teachers.Because the loss of any teachers has the potential to impact studentlearning, there is an urgent need to conduct workforce reductions in away that retains the most effective teachers.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.405RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: (1) School board policies or collective bargaining agreements thatspecify procedures and criteria for identifying certificatedinstructional staff to receive a notice of nonrenewal of contract underRCW 28A.405.210 or 28A.405.220 due to enrollment decline or loss ofrevenue must provide that the contracts of classroom teachers whoreceived comparatively lower evaluation ratings, as described in RCW p. 1 HB 245128A.405.100, are nonrenewed before the contracts of classroom teacherswho received comparatively higher evaluation ratings are nonrenewed. (2) School board policies or collective bargaining agreements thatoutline recall rights for certificated instructional staff must providefor the recall of classroom teachers in the reverse order thatcontracts were nonrenewed under subsection (1) of this section. (3) Nothing in this section may be construed as altering the terms,conditions, or practices contained in any collective bargainingagreement or employment contract in effect on the effective date ofthis section until the expiration date of the agreement or contract. (4) All collective bargaining agreements and other contractsentered into between a school district and an employee bargaining unitor an employee after the effective date of this section, as well asbargaining agreements existing on the effective date of this sectionbut renewed or extended after the effective date of this section, mustbe consistent with this section.
